templates.name: api_nano_banana_2_1_t2i
templates.title: Nano Banana 2.1: Text to Image
templates.description: Generate images from text prompts using Nano Banana 2.1, Google's fast Gemini-based image model, delivering one finished image with no input files required. Ideal for brand marketing posters, e-commerce product visuals, and IP character series.

templates.name: image_z_image_turbo
templates.title: Z-Image-Turbo: Text to Image
templates.description: An Efficient Image Generation Foundation Model with Single-Stream Diffusion Transformer, supports English & Chinese.

templates.name: video_minimax_h3_i2v
templates.title: MiniMax H3: Image to Video
templates.description: Turn a starting image into a short, high-quality video clip with MiniMax H3, a unified multimodal model that generates visuals and synchronized audio in a single pass. The workflow takes 1 input image and produces 1 video output, with optional text or reference media to steer motion, style, or sound. Ideal for rapid concept visualization, character-driven animation tests, and creating shareable social media clips with built-in sound design.
